scope: All 34 look contact sheets, containing S/E idle, walk_a, work_a, carry, sleep: 340 frame views. Zoomed only indicated additional panels.
method: Actually opened every contact.png using view_image detail=original; observed source, colored skin/hair overlays, and v4 tint for each of the ten frame positions.
Inspected suspected omissions and carry prop boundaries in the individual source/mask/reference/tint audit panels; masks.png was an additional comparison only where listed.
Computed hashes after visual review against the immutable v1 directory; numerical pixel reads corroborate already visually classified coordinates and do not generate semantic PASS verdicts.
coordinate_note: Exact pixel examples use source-frame coordinates. Region bboxes are approximate half-open locations, not authored annotation polygons.
limits: This corpus screen does not replace the separate strict 40-frame hair-silhouette/coverage and prop/clothing audit.
No numeric pass or classifier/reference-mask metric was treated as visual proof.
No full pixel accuracy, hair 50 percent coverage, mask gate acceptance, runtime acceptance, generated-portrait inspection, blind-review participation, or owner approval is claimed.
PASS means no obvious broad error found in the actually viewed panels, not that all boundary pixels are correct.
Dark hair, protected ink, tiny source anatomy, and trim/exposed-skin ambiguity remain explicit where encountered.
These observations are permanently bound to diagnostic v1. A later repair must be reviewed separately and must not overwrite these findings.
